What success looks like in this role:

It's an exciting time to be at Unisys. If you have a passion for disrupting technologies and launching emerging solutions to address client business problems around world, look no further. We are seeking an experienced, innovative Data Scientist with a passion for delivering new industry solutions to market as part of an internal AI Consulting and Advisory group with a mission to identify and & unlock opportunities new AI and Generative AI-based revenue. You will be skilled in a variety of AI, machine learning and/or optimization tools, tenacious and able to deliver robust data-centric solutions across all stages of the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be driven with strong appetite for continuous learning, experimentation, and an aptitude for identifying business value in the latest technical advances. You will work within and across teams and organizations to provide leading-edge solutions that result in profitable revenue growth for Unisys. They must be able to leverage domain industry insight, driven by data, to deliver differentiating outcomes for clients as well as help build new use cases that drive interest from prospects. Ultimately delivering solutions to influence decision-makers, that illuminate the interplay between data production, consumption and business processes, that with will lead to their success.

The candidate must be adept at using large data sets to find opportunities for optimization and using models to test the effectiveness of different courses of action. They must have strong experience using a variety of data mining/data analysis methods, using a variety of data tools, building and implementing models, using/creating algorithms and creating/running simulations. They must have a proven ability to drive business results with their data-based insights. They must be comfortable working with a wide range of stakeholders and functional teams. The right candidate will have a passion for discovering solutions hidden in large data sets and working with stakeholders to improve business outcomes.

Responsibilities:
• Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Generative AI and other relevant industry standards, trends, and products and apply this knowledge to support the design/delivery of innovative solutions that meet customer requirements.
• Take responsibility for the integrity and delivery of the larger solution or major infrastructure solution area as designated in the project plan.
• Deliver research and prototyping innovations; data and requirements gathering; solution scoping and architecture; consulting clients and client facing teams on advanced statistical and machine learning problems.
• Collaborate and coordinate with different functional teams (i.e. business, engineering or product development) to implement models and monitor outcomes.
• Implement large-scale data ecosystems including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud-based platforms
• Ability to interpret problem statements and implement AI solutions techniques independently with independently / proactively / thought-leadership.
• Conceptualize, design, and deliver high-quality solutions, with emphasis on Generative AI, to deliver insightful analysis.
• Design accurate and scalable prediction algorithms, including assessing quality, cleansing, structuring for downstream processing
• Leverage automation, cognitive and science-based techniques to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
• Drive operational efficiency by maintaining their data ecosystems, sourcing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service offerings for continuous insights and improvements
• Mine and analyze data from company databases to drive optimization and improvement of product development, marketing techniques and business strategies.
• Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting and other business outcomes.

You will be successful in this role if you have:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) Master's or PHD in Statistics, Mathematics a plus.
• 10+ years of expert level proficiency in Data Science, Machine learning and AI
• Deep understanding of predictive modeling, machine-learning, clustering and classification techniques, and algorithms
• Expertise with Big Data frameworks and visualization tools (Cassandra, Hadoop, Spark, Tableau)
• Exposure to clients across a variety of industries and domains with the ability to create efficient solutions to complex problems.
• Experience creating and using advanced machine learning algorithms and statistics: regression, simulation, scenario analysis, modeling, clustering, decision trees, neural networks, etc. Strong skills in data-structure
• Experience of working on end-to-end data science pipeline: problem scoping, data gathering, EDA, modelling, insights, visualizations, monitoring and maintenance.
• Problem-solving: Ability to break the problem into small parts and applying relevant techniques to drive required outcomes. Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
• Strong cloud Knowledge on Azure, AWS, Google platforms
• Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SLQ, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
• Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
• Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams.

job_description:
Company Description

C-PLan.IT is an early stage startup on a mission to enable mid-market organizations to measure and maximize value from IT investments. We are building an AI Digital Assistant delivered as-a service in real time to support IT investment decision making and value optimization.

Unlike competitive solutions that focus on cost or asset management only C-Plan.IT specializes in IT investment management with a particular focus on digital transformation objectives.

The benefits of using C-Plan.IT increase as the platform's membership grows toward the bold goal of becoming the world's largest IT investment platform with $100B annual IT investments under management across 2000 organizations in the next 10 years.

Privately funded, we are a fully remote company with a 100% distributed team allowing us to hire the best people regardless of where they are located.

Job Description

Are you a technology leader who is not only passionate about AI but is also excited to be at the forefront of solving one of the most challenging problems that have plagued IT for years and could result in organizations becoming highly challenged or possibly extinct as digital transformation sweeps every sector?

Are you looking for a role with the opportunity to:
• Execute core research in AI knowledge management that leads to patentable technologies?
• Take an idea from research to a commercially successful cloud-based enterprise software product?
• Build a solution that will have a meaningful impact on one-third of the US economy - both for-profit and not-for-profit organizations?

Are you seeking the potential to:
• Be the first to bring a unique combination of AI and data management to the market?
• Work with experienced, successful Silicon Valley entrepreneurs with 4X startup experience leading to IPO and acquisition exits?
• Be mentored by a team of research advisors known in the industry as thought leaders?
• Participate in a Silicon Valley-style equity opportunity within a venture with the potential for significant value creation?
• Work with a company built around a remote model before COVID-19 made it a requirement?
• Give back to your community through a 1-1-1 philanthropic model as pioneered by Marc Benioff's Salesforce?

Qualifications

The Essentials:
• Master or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Operation Research or other equivalent quantitative fields
• Experience in AI with a demonstrated understanding of expert systems, knowledge management, and digital assistants
• Experience managing a team of data scientists and AI researchers and engineers using Agile methodologies and tools
• Previous startup experience with a proven track record of leading teams that drive innovation and deliver products in a fast-paced, high-energy environment
• Excited to work with new technologies and approaches
• Experience working within an SBIR NSF (Small Business Innovation Research - National Science Foundation) Program grant award model

Responsibilities:
• Get to know our customer (or know them already) and use that empathy to inform shaping the product's vision and requirements and building an exceptional product
• Serve as a thought leader and technology strategy driver along with the CEO and Co-Founders to make decisions on the product technology architecture including building block components - with a preference for open source technologies
• Build, build, build - especially in the early days, you will be rolling up your sleeves and writing code, from core platform to fixing bugs
• Help form a top-performing team of talented and responsible software engineers, data scientists and product designers, and provide them the freedom to be creative and innovative
• Lead product engineering including research and development of unique proprietary and patentable intellectual property that yields competitive advantages
• Embody the company's culture and mission by fostering a culture that is passionate about building awesome products that deliver measurable value and a customer experience that delights
• Evangelize the company's technology vision, roadmap and capabilities with customers, investors, employees, and other stakeholders
• Stay current on technology advances in the field of AI - especially digital assistants, knowledge engineering, data-driven reasoning, expert systems - and in the field of data management - including column databases and other advanced decision analytics technologies

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Chicago, IL, USA.Minimum qualifications:

• 7 years of experience in technical project management, stakeholder management, professional services, solution engineering or technical consulting.
• 1 year of experience in technical troubleshooting and writing code in one or more programming languages.
• Experience with LLMs, Open Source, Big Data, Machine Learning, and numerical programming frameworks.

Preferred qualifications:
• Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
• Experience architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems and with machine learning technologies.
• Experience with building AI and machine learning solutions, Machine Learning Operation frameworks such as Kubeflow, and leveraging specific machine learning architectures (e.g., deep learning, LSTM, etc.).
• Understanding of AI Models, Large Language Models, and AI specialized infrastructure especially as it relates to AI trends and issues within businesses.
• Understanding of responsible AI practice.

About The Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Generative AI Specialist, you will work with Product Development and Technical Sales teams as an Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) subject matter expert to bring Google Cloud AI products to our customers and Partners.

In this role, you will help prospective customers and partners understand the power of Google AI, explaining technical features, helping customers design architectures, build AI powered applications, and problem-solving any potential roadblocks. You will also have the opportunity to help customers leverage Google Cloud’s Generative AI services, including Large Language Models (LLM) and specialized Machine Learning (ML) hardware developed by Google.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $171,000-$257,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Support developers, creators, and enterprises to leverage Google’s Generative Language APIs so they can build their own AI products in the future.

job_description:
M365 Research and the Privacy Preserving Machine Learning Initiative are looking for a Senior Researcher to explore privacy and confidentiality aspects of machine learning. The role offers the unique opportunity to work in close collaboration with colleagues in Microsoft Research (MSR), Azure Research, Microsoft 365 and other product groups. Our researchers pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including private and efficient AI, AIOps, and responsible AI, with applications to a wide range of business, consumer, and scientific domains.

We are seeking candidates to explore various topics of PPML, including:
• Privacy mitigations in machine learning, such as differentially private (DP) training, with an emphasis on Large Language Models (LLMs),
• Advancing approaches for synthetic data generation with privacy guarantees,
• Auditing privacy mitigations,
• Privacy attacks, including membership inference, poisoning attacks, and reconstruction attacks,
• Privacy vs fairness tensions in AI systems,
• Private and trustworthy grounding in retrieval-augmented systems,
• Novel applications of privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), including but not limited to applications of DP, multi-party computation, and confidential computing.
• Federated Learning and analytics,
• Multi-party data collaboration

We encourage senior researchers with relevant technical background in any of these topics to apply. This role is located in Redmond and is co-located with Microsoft Research.

Required/Minimum Qualifications
• Doctorate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Machine Learning or related fields
• OR equivalent experience.
• Experience publishing as a lead or essential author in top conferences/journals in at least one of the following areas: machine learning, privacy, security, responsible AI, federated learning, natural language processing, computer vision.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications
• Background in machine learning and deep learning; experience with large language models and their applications in areas such as text generation, sentiment analysis, language translation, or conversational AI. Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs;
• Familiarity with state-of-the-art practices and methodologies in security and privacy such as differential privacy, information flow control, secure multi-party computation, and homomorphic encryption;
• Track record in research, as evidenced by high-quality publications;
• Publications at leading NLP conferences such as NIPS, ICML, ICLR, EMNLP and ACL;
• Software development skills and experience, preferably deep learning frameworks such as Python and PyTorch.
